user.title: Set up HealthLink
user.description: HealthLink lists iOS/iPadOS devices (iPhone/iPad) registered to this Home Assistant server through the official Companion app. Devices are shown even before Apple Health Sensors (Labs) is enabled. Found: {device_count}; unassigned: {available_device_count}. Create one health profile per person and select only that person's Apple devices.

general.title: Devices, goals and privacy
general.description: This is the standard Home Assistant integration settings flow. HealthLink Studio is a separate sidebar feature panel. Multiple iPhones/iPads owned by the same person can be selected together; use a separate health profile for another person.

data_description.companion_device_ids: iOS/iPadOS devices registered to this HA server through the official Companion app. Apple Watch itself is not a selectable device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: HealthLink stays local. Sensitive health metrics are not exposed as normal Home Assistant entities unless you explicitly allow them.

data.enable_sensitive: Allow sensitive health metrics as HA entities

goals.title: Personal wellness goals
goals.description: Set only the goals you want. Zero disables a goal. HealthLink does not choose medical or population targets for you.

metrics.title: Health metric exposure
metrics.description: Only discovered metrics are listed. Existing steps/activity/sleep summary sensors are preserved. Sensitive values exposed as normal HA entities may be visible to other HA users; verify your sharing and access settings.

import_data.title: Import health records and ECG
import_data.description: Easiest path: on iPhone/iPad open Health → profile picture → Export All Health Data → Export → Save to Files, then select the resulting export.zip here. Target profile: {profile}. Labs does not currently send ECG automatically, so ECG requires a source file that actually contains ECG records. Enable sensitive health data first when importing ECG. A doctor-sharing ECG PDF is not a raw waveform import format. Uploaded files are processed locally and then deleted.
